display_name: 省略中间分类的完整七景预测一致性核验
description: 固定已完成的跨视图候选，跳过未使用的 DURA anchor 分类，逐条比较全部七景 raw 和恢复预测决策；不连接真值。

data.dataset: Phase1 Main split fixed ground inputs
data.representation: source-only smoke then fixed received ground IQ and previously completed raw/restored class predictions

roles.U_s: source smoke IQ with TX hidden
roles.test: fixed ground received IQ and existing predictions; no truth or fitting

permissions.query_use: Read fixed per-record test IQ and existing prediction arrays only; no truth, fitting, or model selection
permissions.claim_scope: Complete prediction decision parity and replay time for one fixed candidate; no new performance score or independent blind-test claim

checkpoint.initialization: Fixed source-only crossview-guard correction, original DURA v1.0, frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: ground.load_fixed verifies matching source-only G checkpoint and frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Fixed source-only checkpoints, no target ancestry; F read only for frozen prediction diagnostic
checkpoint.selection_rule: Preselected completed fixed crossview candidate solely for technical parity, regardless of its reported accuracy; no target-driven optimization

expected_artifacts: source_smoke.json: fixed source logits equality and pilot decisions
result.json: all seven view decision parity and elapsed time

dimensions: 168000 fixed ground records x seven views

rows.method: Compare full fixed original raw and restored class decisions with same inputs after skipping unused anchor-reader forward
rows.purpose: Determine complete output parity for one fixed G and measure replay time
rows.seed_notes: Existing fixed crossview-guard source G and Tri-SIG-TIME SSL seed 2026092701; no training or selection.
rows.scenario: Phase1 Main split clean and six practical views
expected_artifacts: source_smoke.json: fixed source logits equality and pilot decisions
result.json: all seven view decision parity and elapsed time

notes: The candidate was already trained, frozen and fully predicted; its preselection is for a technical replay, not new model selection or tuning.
First verify 112 source records for equal logits and fixed source pilot decisions; then compare all saved ground class decisions chunk by chunk without reading any ground truth.
One mismatch stops this diagnostic and preserves evidence; output parity covers class decisions only because original ground logits were not stored.

Elapsed replay time includes input reading and prediction comparison but not model loading or source smoke; historical baseline ran at a different time/load, so any duration comparison is not a controlled parallel-speed claim.
Existing live predictions are not interrupted or changed.
Corrected the seed_notes method typo from tail-excess to crossview-guard; actual registered parent, executed command and parity artifacts always identify crossview-guard.
